Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: one full-body static character sprite of Queenie for the 2D fighting game Digital Circus Encore. Original SMG4 crossover: SMG4 · Hommage · SMG4. Reference 1 is Queenie's anatomy, reference 2 is the game's 2D style, reference 3 is SMG4 clothing colors only — do NOT copy frog anatomy.
Original Encore crossover design of Queenie from The Amazing Digital Circus, not a canonical outfit. Keep the recognizable queen-chess-piece silhouette: tall honey-brown turned-wood head with pointed scalloped crown and spherical finial, exactly two protruding white eyes with red-orange irises, heavy wooden eyelids, two black lashes below each eye; no mouth or nose. One continuous tapered chess-piece body with a broad circular base and two completely detached floating white gloves, no arms or legs. Crisp fine dark outlines, polished hand-painted 2D cel shading, detailed yet legible at game scale. Preserve Queenie chess anatomy. Translate the existing Encore SMG4 homage design into a continuous long white overall-pinafore around her conical chess body, royal-blue shirtfront and side panels, two gold hexagonal bib buttons, blue belt, tiny black camera on belt. Royal-blue soft cap with plain white round camera-symbol badge fitted to front of crown; preserve visible crown peaks and finial above/behind cap. White detached gloves. No human legs, shoes, mustache or face; no lettering.
Pose and framing: motionless relaxed combat guard three-quarter facing RIGHT. Eyes look right. The full character from spherical finial down to her integrated chess-body base fits inside the frame, with ample clear transparent margins; both detached gloves fully visible. Top-down or perspective tilt forbidden. No animation, action attack or extra views.
Rendering: crisp dark outlines, polished hand-painted 2D cel shading, rich fine detail readable at game scale. Transparent RGBA with no colored halo, glow or drop shadow. Remove any separate commercial black display pedestal. No scene, floor, text, lettering, watermarks, unrelated props or extra figures. ONE character per PNG, portrait 1024x1536 composition.
